author: gbolahan
content:
What I'm addressing isn't a diff issue, I'm purely addressing the need for a full snapshot when we take them. i.e the first layer (of diff), as it is in, both lighthouse and prysm stores the full snapshot. For lighthouse, it is 291 days for the first layer of full snapshot.

Issue is that, in the full snapshot (every 291 days - as in lighthouse), validators is still 99.9% the same in between , while being ~85% of full state.

Sectors with structural sharing keeps the immutable mostly once instead of storing again, even if it takes almost 300 days

Perhaps, possible to reduce the time between first layer checkpoint with this design
